> #### [**SEA SURFACE TEMPERATURE (SST) DATA SOURCE :**]{.underline}
>
> **"GHRSST Level 4 MUR Global Foundation Sea Surface Temperature Analysis (v4.1)" (MUR-JPL-L4-GLOB-v4.1)**
>
> - DOI: [10.5067/GHGMR-4FJ04](https://doi.org/10.5067/GHGMR-4FJ04); Institution: NASA (JPL)
> - Spatial Resolution: [**0.01°**]{.underline} (DD); Spatial Coverage: Global
> - Temporal Resolution: [**Daily**]{.underline}; Time Span: 2002/05/31 – Present
> - Geographic coordinate system ([**EPSG:4326**]{.underline}): "GCS_WGS_1984" / Datum: "D_WGS_1984" / Spheroid: "WGS_1984", semimajor axis=6378137.000000, inverse flattening=298.257224
>
> *`*Accessed from NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/ [Dataset ID: jplMURSST41; Title: "Multi-scale Ultra-high Resolution (MUR) SST Analysis fv04.1, Global, 0.01°, 2002-present, Daily"]`*
>
> ------------------------------------------------------------------------
>
> #### [**SEA SURFACE SALINITY (SSS) DATA SOURCE :**]{.underline}
>
> **"Global Ocean Physics Analysis and Forecast: Salinity, daily" (cmems_mod_glo_phy-so_anfc_0.083deg_P1D-m)**
>
> - DOI: [10.48670/moi-00016](https://doi.org/10.48670/moi-00016); Institution: Copernicus Marine Service
> - Spatial Resolution: [**0.083°**]{.underline} (DD); Spatial Coverage: Global (excluding southernmost 10° in Antarctica)
> - Temporal Resolution: [**Daily**]{.underline}; Time Span: 2022/06/01 – 2026/07/31
> - Geographic coordinate system ([**EPSG:4326**]{.underline}): "GCS_WGS_1984"
> - Projected coordinate system ([**EPSG:3857**]{.underline}): "WGS_1984_Web_Mercator_Auxiliary_Sphere"
>
> ------------------------------------------------------------------------
>
> #### [**SEA SURFACE CHLOROPHYLL-A (CHL) DATA SOURCE :**]{.underline}
>
> **"Global 2 km Chlorophyll Concentration Daily DINEOF, Merged VIIRS SNPP-N20 and OLCI S3A"**
>
> - DOI: [10.5067/NOAA-20/VIIRS/L3M/CHL/2022.0](https://doi.org/10.5067/NOAA-20/VIIRS/L3M/CHL/2022.0); Institution: NASA
> - Spatial Resolution: [**2 km**]{.underline}; Spatial Coverage: Global
> - Temporal Resolution: [**Daily**]{.underline}; Time Span: 2017/11/29 – Present
> - Geographic coordinate system ([**EPSG:4326**]{.underline}): "GCS_WGS_1984"

*SEARCH "#‼️" TO FIND LINES WHERE FILE PATHS NEED TO BE CHANGED FOR CURRENT MISSION*

```{r}
library(rerddap)
library(terra)
library(sdmpredictors)
library(corrplot)
library(ncdf4)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyterra)
library(ncdf4)
```

# [BATHYMETRY DATA (MY RASTER)]{.underline}

Use bathymetry raster cropped to mission boundary (in ArcGIS) for extent of MaxEnt variable maps

```{r}
#‼️‼️ UPDATE FILE PATH FOR MISSION
bathy_raster <- rast("/Users/keileygregory/THESIS_REPOSITORIES/MISSION_REPOSITORIES/UVI2_Around_STX_20250306/data/5_data_gis/rasters_shapefiles/GBC15a_bathy_p26920_v6642.tif")

# tell terra to treat this value as NA
bathy_raster[bathy_raster == -32768] <- NA

# print CRS + resolution of bathy raster to double check (*ref_grid downstream uses res = 1000 meters, so bathy must be in a projected CRS)
crs(bathy_raster, describe = TRUE)
res(bathy_raster)

# if the raster loads in geographic degrees, project to UTM 20N before continuing
if (is.lonlat(bathy_raster)) {
  bathy_raster <- project(bathy_raster, "EPSG:26920", method = "bilinear")
}

# print extent lat/lon values of bathymetry raster (prints lat/lon even if in UTM)
ext(project(bathy_raster, "EPSG:4326"))
```

```{r}
t_end   <- as.POSIXct(date_end,   format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
```

# [SST, SSS, AND CHL-A DATA (PUBLIC SOURCES)]{.underline}

### [SEA SURFACE WATER TEMPERATURE (SST)]{.underline}

Import SST data from NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP

```{r}
sst_erd <- info("jplMURSST41", url = "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/")
print(sst_erd)

# pull SST data from loaded dataset
sst_raw <- griddap(
  sst_erd,
  fields    = "analysed_sst",
  time      = c(date_start, date_end),
  latitude  = c(lat_min, lat_max),
  longitude = c(lon_min, lon_max),
  fmt       = "nc",
  store     = disk(geo_path)
)

# rename downloaded .nc file (griddap names it by hash, so pull path from the returned object)
sst_file <- file.path(geo_path, "sst_maxent_env_stack_mur_nasajpl.nc")
file.rename(sst_raw$summary$filename, sst_file)
```

Load data from downloaded .nc file

```{r}
sst_file <- file.path(geo_path, "sst_maxent_env_stack_mur_nasajpl.nc")
sst_nc <- rast(sst_file)
print(sst_nc)
```

Read the documented valid range from the variable attributes

```{r}
sst_meta <- nc_open(sst_file)
ncatt_get(sst_meta, "analysed_sst", "valid_min")$value
ncatt_get(sst_meta, "analysed_sst", "valid_max")$value
nc_close(sst_meta)
```

Clamp values to [valid]{.underline} range from metadata print-out above

```{r}
#‼️‼️ UPDATE VALUES BASED ON METADATA 
sst_nc_clamp <- clamp(sst_nc, lower = -7, upper = 60, values = FALSE)
sst_nc_clamp <- setMinMax(sst_nc_clamp)

# verify range (should be ~25-30 °C for Caribbean)
global(sst_nc_clamp, "range", na.rm = TRUE)
```

Calculate mean across mission period

```{r}
sst_mean <- mean(sst_nc_clamp, na.rm = TRUE)
names(sst_mean) <- "SST"
```

Export SST maxent data as GeoTIFF + plot data and export as PNG

```{r}
writeRaster(sst_mean, file.path(geo_path, "sstmean_maxent_env_stack_mur_nasajpl.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)

png(file.path(geo_path, "sstmean_maxent_env_stack_mur_nasajpl.png"), width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
plot(sst_mean, main = "SST Mean (°C) - UVI2_Around_STX_20250306")
dev.off()
```

### [SEA SURFACE SALINITY (SSS)]{.underline}

Import from Copernicus "GLOBAL_ANALYSISFORECAST_PHY_001_024" product

```{r}
system(paste(
  "copernicusmarine subset",
  "--dataset-id cmems_mod_glo_phy-so_anfc_0.083deg_P1D-m",
  "--variable so",
  "--start-datetime", date_start,
  "--end-datetime", date_end,
  "--minimum-longitude", lon_min,
  "--maximum-longitude", lon_max,
  "--minimum-latitude",  lat_min,
  "--maximum-latitude",  lat_max,
  "--minimum-depth 0",
  # use 5 m because same depth used for sea surface variables in interpolation scripts
  "--maximum-depth 5",
  "--output-filename sss_maxent_env_stack_anfc_cmems.nc",
  "--output-directory", shQuote(geo_path),
  "--overwrite"
))
```

Load data from downloaded .nc file

```{r}
ncatt_get(sss_meta, "so", "valid_max")$value
```

Clamp values to [valid]{.underline} range from metadata print-out above

### [SEA SURFACE CHLOROPHYLL-A (CHL-A)]{.underline}

> *`*Originally* accessed from https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/ [Dataset ID: noaacwNPPN20S3ASCIDINEOF2kmDaily; Title: "Chlorophyll (Gap-Filled DINEOF), NOAA S-NPP, NOAA-20 VIIRS and Copernicus S-3A OLCI, Science Quality, Global 2km, Daily"] but it has been removed - so now use alternative pathway to access data (see data source description at top of script) *data is exact same, just stored at different locations*`*

```{r}
#‼️‼️ UPDATE YEAR IN URL TO MATCH MISSION YEAR
chl_dap_url <- "https://coastwatch.noaa.gov/thredds/dodsC/CoastWatch/Merged/DINEOF2km/chlora/DailyGlobal/WW00/2025"

chl_file <- file.path(geo_path, "chla_maxent_env_stack_dineof2km.nc")

# open remote dataset over OPeNDAP (reads metadata only, no data yet)
chl_dap <- nc_open(chl_dap_url)

# read the coordinate axes to find index ranges for the mission box and dates
chl_lon  <- ncvar_get(chl_dap, "lon")
chl_lat  <- ncvar_get(chl_dap, "lat")
chl_time <- as.POSIXct(ncvar_get(chl_dap, "time"), origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC")

lon_idx <- which(chl_lon >= lon_min & chl_lon <= lon_max)
lat_idx <- which(chl_lat >= lat_min & chl_lat <= lat_max)

# server's time axis is out of order, so find matching indices and sort them chronologically
t_idx <- which(chl_time >= t_start & chl_time <= t_end)
t_idx <- t_idx[order(chl_time[t_idx])]
# should be 19
length(t_idx)

# pull one day at a time (ncdf4 dimension order is lon, lat, altitude, time)
chl_layers <- lapply(t_idx, function(i) {
  m <- ncvar_get(chl_dap, "chlor_a",
                 start = c(min(lon_idx), min(lat_idx), 1, i),
                 count = c(length(lon_idx), length(lat_idx), 1, 1))
  # transpose so rows = lat and cols = lon (lat is stored north to south, so north ends up on top)
  rast(t(m))
})
nc_close(chl_dap)

# stack the days and attach real coordinates (cell edges = cell centers +/- half a cell)
chl_nc <- rast(chl_layers)
half_res <- abs(diff(chl_lon[1:2])) / 2
ext(chl_nc) <- c(min(chl_lon[lon_idx]) - half_res, max(chl_lon[lon_idx]) + half_res,
                 min(chl_lat[lat_idx]) - half_res, max(chl_lat[lat_idx]) + half_res)
crs(chl_nc)  <- "EPSG:4326"
time(chl_nc) <- chl_time[t_idx]
names(chl_nc) <- paste0("chlor_a_", format(chl_time[t_idx], "%Y%m%d"))
print(chl_nc)

# save locally so downstream steps can rast(chl_file) like SST/SSS
writeCDF(chl_nc, chl_file, varname = "chlor_a", unit = "mg m^-3", overwrite = TRUE)
```

Read the documented valid range from the variable attributes

```{r}
chl_dodsc_url <- "https://coastwatch.noaa.gov/thredds/dodsC/CoastWatch/Merged/DINEOF2km/chlora/DailyGlobal/WW00/2025"
chl_meta <- nc_open(chl_dodsc_url)
ncatt_get(chl_meta, "chlor_a", "valid_min")$value
ncatt_get(chl_meta, "chlor_a", "valid_max")$value
nc_close(chl_meta)
```

Clamp values to [valid]{.underline} range from metadata print-out above

```{r}
#‼️‼️ UPDATE VALUES BASED ON METADATA
chl_nc_clamp <- clamp(chl_nc, lower = 0.001, upper = 100, values = FALSE)
chl_nc_clamp <- setMinMax(chl_nc_clamp)

# verify range
global(chl_nc_clamp, "range", na.rm = TRUE)
```

Calculate mean across mission period

```{r}
chl_mean <- mean(chl_nc_clamp, na.rm = TRUE)
names(chl_mean) <- "Chl"
```

Log-transform for habitat model since Chl-a is typically log-normally distributed *(fixes color scale being stretched by a few high nearshore pixels)*

```{r}
chl_mean_log <- log(chl_mean)
names(chl_mean_log) <- "Chl_log"
```

Export Chl-a maxent data as GeoTIFF + plot data and export as PNG

```{r}
writeRaster(chl_mean_log, file.path(geo_path, "chlameanlog_maxent_env_stack_dineof2km.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)

png(file.path(geo_path, "chlameanlog_maxent_env_stack_dineof2km.png"), width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
plot(chl_mean_log, main = "log(Chl-a) (mg m^-3) - UVI2_Around_STX_20250306")
dev.off()
```

# [RESAMPLE AND REPROJECT DATA]{.underline}

Reference grid from bathy resample target = 1km in UTM units *(creates empty template raster that matches spatial extent and CRS of `bathy_raster` -BUT- with fixed resolution of 1000 m × 1000 m)*

```{r}
# confirm bathy is in a projected CRS with meter units before using it as template
stopifnot(!is.lonlat(bathy_raster))

# build reference grid
ref_grid <- rast(ext = ext(bathy_raster), res = 1000, crs = crs(bathy_raster))
```

Warp `bathy_raster` onto 1 km grid *(\***bilinear interpolation** estimates each new cell depth value as weighted average of four nearest source cells)*

```{r}
bathy_1km <- resample(bathy_raster, ref_grid, method = "bilinear")
names(bathy_1km) <- "bathymetry"
```

Create ocean mask to remove land areas

```{r}
ocean_mask  <- !is.na(bathy_1km)
```

### [CALCULATE SLOPE ON UTM 1 KM GRID]{.underline}

Calculate slope at native bathy resolution, then resample to 1 km (deriving slope from the already-resampled 1 km bathy flattens real gradients)

```{r}
slope_native <- terrain(bathy_raster, v = "slope", unit = "degrees")
slope_1km <- resample(slope_native, ref_grid, method = "bilinear")
names(slope_1km) <- "slope"
```

Gap-fill slope NA cells (uses iterative focal mean with 3x3 window, repeats until all ocean cells are filled)

```{r}
cat("Slope NA cells before gap-fill:", global(is.na(slope_1km) & ocean_mask, "sum")[[1]], "\n")
slope_filled <- slope_1km
max_iter     <- 50
for (i in seq_len(max_iter)) {
  na_count <- global(is.na(slope_filled) & ocean_mask, "sum")[[1]]
  if (na_count == 0) break
  slope_filled <- focal(slope_filled, w = 3, fun = "mean", na.policy = "only", na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("  Gap-fill iteration", i, "— remaining NA ocean cells:",
      global(is.na(slope_filled) & ocean_mask, "sum")[[1]], "\n")
}

# re-apply ocean mask so land cells stay NA
slope_filled <- mask(slope_filled, bathy_1km)
names(slope_filled) <- "slope"
cat("Slope NA cells after gap-fill:", global(is.na(slope_filled) & ocean_mask, "sum")[[1]], "\n")
slope_1km <- slope_filled
```

### [REPROJECT SST TO UTM 1 KM + APPLY OCEAN MASK]{.underline}

```{r}
sst <- rast(file.path(geo_path, "sstmean_maxent_env_stack_mur_nasajpl.tif"))
sst_1km <- project(sst, ref_grid, method = "bilinear")
names(sst_1km) <- "SST"
```

Gap-fill SST NA cells (uses iterative focal mean with 3x3 window, repeats until all ocean cells are filled)

```{r}
cat("SST NA cells before gap-fill:", global(is.na(sst_1km) & ocean_mask, "sum")[[1]], "\n")
sst_1km <- mask(sst_1km, bathy_1km)
names(sst_1km) <- "SST"

sst_filled <- sst_1km
max_iter    <- 50
for (i in seq_len(max_iter)) {
  na_count <- global(is.na(sst_filled) & ocean_mask, "sum")[[1]]
  if (na_count == 0) break
  sst_filled <- focal(sst_filled, w = 3, fun = "mean", na.policy = "only", na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("  Gap-fill iteration", i, "— remaining NA ocean cells:", 
      global(is.na(sst_filled) & ocean_mask, "sum")[[1]], "\n")
}

# re-apply ocean mask to SSS so land cells stay NA
sst_filled <- mask(sst_filled, bathy_1km)
names(sst_filled) <- "SST"
cat("SST NA cells after gap-fill:", global(is.na(sst_filled) & ocean_mask, "sum")[[1]], "\n")
sst_1km <- sst_filled
```

### [REPROJECT CHL-A TO UTM 1 KM + APPLY OCEAN MASK]{.underline}

```{r}
chl <- rast(file.path(geo_path, "chlameanlog_maxent_env_stack_dineof2km.tif"))
chl_1km <- project(chl, ref_grid, method = "bilinear")
names(chl_1km) <- "Chl_log"
```

Gap-fill Chl-a NA cells (uses iterative focal mean with 3x3 window, repeats until all ocean cells are filled)

```{r}

chl_filled <- chl_1km
max_iter    <- 50
for (i in seq_len(max_iter)) {
  na_count <- global(is.na(chl_filled) & ocean_mask, "sum")[[1]]
  if (na_count == 0) break
  chl_filled <- focal(chl_filled, w = 3, fun = "mean", na.policy = "only", na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("  Gap-fill iteration", i, "— remaining NA ocean cells:", 
      global(is.na(chl_filled) & ocean_mask, "sum")[[1]], "\n")
}

# re-apply ocean mask to Chl-a so land cells stay NA
chl_filled <- mask(chl_filled, bathy_1km)
names(chl_filled) <- "Chl_log"
cat("Chl-a NA cells after gap-fill:", global(is.na(chl_filled) & ocean_mask, "sum")[[1]], "\n")
chl_1km <- chl_filled
```

*(\*NOTE: distance to nearest shoreline does NOT need to be resampled/reprojected)*

# [SHORELINE DATA (MY SHAPEFILE)]{.underline}

Load shoreline data from CARIBBEAN_SHORELINES shapefile

***\*Directory [must]{.underline} also have .dbf, .prj, and .shx sidecar files in same folder as .shp file***

```{r}
#‼️‼️ UPDATE FILE PATH FOR MISSION
shore <- vect("/Users/keileygregory/THESIS_REPOSITORIES/MISSION_REPOSITORIES/UVI2_Around_STX_20250306/data/5_data_gis/rasters_shapefiles/caribbean_shorelines_shapefile/CARIBBEAN_SHORELINES.shp")

# crop to map extent
shore_crop <- project(shore, crs(bathy_1km))
```

Compute distance from each raster cell to nearest shoreline (meters)

```{r}
dist_shore <- distance(bathy_1km, shore_crop)
dist_shore <- mask(dist_shore, bathy_1km)
names(dist_shore) <- "dist_shore"
```

Export shoreline maxent data as GeoTIFF + plot data and export as PNG

```{r}
writeRaster(dist_shore, file.path(geo_path, "shoredist_maxent_env_stack.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)

png(file.path(geo_path, "shoredist_maxent_env_stack.png"), width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
plot(dist_shore, main = "Distance to Nearest Shoreline (m) - UVI2_Around_STX_20250306")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
env_stack <- c(bathy_1km, slope_1km, dist_shore, sst_1km, sss_1km, chl_1km)

# count cells at the fill value
global(bathy_raster == -32768, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
writeRaster(bathy_1km,   file.path(geo_path, "bathy_1km_UTM20N.tif"),     overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(slope_1km,   file.path(geo_path, "slope_1km_UTM20N.tif"),     overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(dist_shore,  file.path(geo_path, "distshore_1km_UTM20N.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(sst_1km,     file.path(geo_path, "sst_1km_UTM20N.tif"),       overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(sss_1km,     file.path(geo_path, "sss_1km_UTM20N.tif"),       overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(chl_1km,     file.path(geo_path, "chllog_1km_UTM20N.tif"),    overwrite = TRUE)
```

Plot stack and export as PNG

```{r}
png(file.path(env_out_path, "maxent_env_stack_1km_UTM20N.png"), width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
plot(env_stack)
dev.off()
```

# [CORRELATIONS]{.underline}

Extract values from stack ***(\*ocean pixels only, no NA)***

```{r}
env_df <- as.data.frame(env_stack, na.rm = TRUE)
head(env_df)
nrow(env_df)
```

Correlation matrix

```{r}
cor_matrix <- cor(env_df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
round(cor_matrix, 3)
```

Visualize correlation matrix and export as PNG

```{r}
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "number", type = "upper", 
         tl.col = "black", tl.cex = 0.9)

png(file.path(env_out_path, "correlation_matrix_maxent_env_stack.png"), width = 8, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "number", type = "upper", tl.col = "black", tl.cex = 0.9)
dev.off()
```

Export final stack

```{r}
writeRaster(env_stack, file.path(env_out_path, "maxent_env_stack_1km_UTM20N.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
```
